label: IBM Cloud VPC
desc: Software-defined private network for virtual servers, load balancers, and attached IBM Cloud services. Full IaaS mapping lives on the Infrastructure view.
value: The x86 landing zone. Data & AI products attach here rather than replacing VPC. Tie-ins for this view are not drawn yet.

Are IKS or ROKS clusters going to land on these subnets?
Full IaaS mapping lives on the Infrastructure view. Data & AI edges are next.

label: IBM Kubernetes Service
desc: Managed Kubernetes on IBM Cloud VPC. Full IaaS mapping lives on the Infrastructure view.

label: Red Hat OpenShift
